title: Recognise the Quadratic
text: This is a quadratic equation in $$\sin x$$. Treat $$\sin x$$ as a single variable.

title: Factorising Method
text: For $$2u^2 - u - 1$$, find factors of $$2 \times (-1) = -2$$ that add to $$-1$$.\n\nFactors: $$-2$$ and $$+1$$ (since $$-2 + 1 = -1$$)

title: Complete the Factorisation
text:
$$2\sin^2 x - \sin x - 1 = (2\sin x + 1)(\sin x - 1)$$

Verify: $$(2\sin x)(\sin x) + (2\sin x)(-1) + (1)(\sin x) + (1)(-1)$$
$$= 2\sin^2 x - 2\sin x + \sin x - 1 = 2\sin^2 x - \sin x - 1$$ ✓
